name: Stryd Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: strydus

sections.description:
Stryd Payment Gateway enables your WooCommerce store to accept ACH bank transfer payments securely and efficiently. Lower your payment processing costs compared to credit cards while providing customers with a convenient payment option.

Features:

  • Secure ACH bank transfer payments
  • Direct integration with Stryd payment processing
  • WooCommerce Checkout Blocks support
  • Test mode for development
  • Automatic order status updates
  • Plaid-verified bank connections
  • Lower transaction fees than credit cards

Why Choose Stryd?

  • Lower Fees: Save money compared to credit card processing
  • Bank-Grade Security: Plaid-verified connections ensure secure transactions
  • Easy Setup: Get started in minutes with simple API key configuration
  • Reliable: 99.9% uptime with enterprise-grade infrastructure

External services

This plugin connects to external services provided by Stryd (operated by PayGen LLC) to process ACH bank transfer payments. The connection is required for the plugin to function.

What data is sent:

  • Order ID and order key (to identify the transaction)
  • Payment amount (to process the correct payment)
  • Customer return URL (to redirect after payment)
  • Your Stryd API key (for authentication)

When data is sent:

  • When validating your API key during plugin configuration
  • When a customer proceeds to checkout with this payment method
  • When fetching your merchant logo (optional feature)

Service provider:

This service is provided by Stryd, operated by PayGen LLC.

  • Service website: https://stryd.us
  • Terms of Service: https://stryd.us/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://stryd.us/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stryd-payment-gateway-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments to configure the plugin.
  4. Enable “Stryd Payment” and enter your API key from your Stryd dashboard.

Configuration:

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments
  2. Find “Stryd Payment” in the payment methods list
  3. Click “Set up” or “Manage”
  4. Enable the payment method
  5. Enter your Stryd API key (get it from https://stryd.us/dashboard)
  6. Configure the required URLs
  7. Click “Save changes”
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Stryd API key?

Sign up at https://stryd.us and navigate to your dashboard to generate an API key.

What are the transaction fees?

Stryd charges 3% + $2 per transaction, which is typically lower than credit card processing fees.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes! Stryd uses Plaid for bank verification, which is the same technology used by major financial institutions. All data is encrypted and transmitted securely.

Does this work with WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes, the plugin fully supports WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

Can I test the plugin before going live?

Yes, enable Test Mode in the plugin settings to test without processing real transactions.
